sermons.title: Sermon 2077 | The Gospel of the Glory of Christ

scripture.verse: "The light of the glorious Gospel of Christ."
"And he said unto Jesus, Lord, remember me when thou comest into thy kingdom. And Jesus said unto him, Verily I say unto thee, To day shalt thou be with me in paradise."'Luke 23:42-43.
"The heart knows his own bitterness. And a stranger does not understand with his joy."

sermons.title: Sermon 2080 | The Power of His Resurrection

scripture.verse: "That I may know Him and the power of His resurrection."
"And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten."

"How think you? If a man has an hundred sheep and one of them is gone astray, does he not lea ve the ninety and nine and go into the mountains and seek that which is gone astray? And if he should find it, verily I say unto you, he rejoices more of that sheep, than of the ninety and nine which went not astray."

sermons.title: Sermon 2084 | The Bible Tried and Proved

scripture.verse: "The Words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times."

sermons.title: Sermon 2085 | A Dirge for the Down-grade and a Song For Faith

scripture.verse: "Rejoice for joy with her, all you that mourn for her."
